svg.title: SHIPPING news collection and report drafting flowchart
svg.desc: Two connected stages show RSS collection, filtering, article extraction, saved archives, separate report classification, decision branches, output files and editorial review.
svg.text: SHIPPING: from news feeds to report drafts
Follow the arrows through collection, then a separately invoked report run. Branches show what happens to each story.

g.text: Extract headlines, links, dates and excerpts.
Remove blocked domains and tracking parameters.
Ollama / qwen3:8b reads the headline + excerpt.
Keep maritime emissions policy, sustainable fuels
Retain saved text on timeout; otherwise use the
feed excerpt with error=Y if no body is available.
Keep title, source, body, description and firstEyes.
The collection script has no sentiment scoring.

svg.text: Archive input to a separate report run

g.text: Load archive & choose the report window
Default: last 72 hours of firstEyes (first observed).
Set cutoff, lookback and AM / PM / adhoc edition.
Keep records observed inside the selected window.
Clear existing manual category and ordering fields.
Check URLs, cutoff dates and explicit --sent-csv files.
Already sent / duplicate URL: audit only.
Invalid URL or future publication: review.
Uses title + description + a short body excerpt.
If error=Y, omit the body from model input.
The title and description still inform scoring.
Propose Policy, Industry, Technology and other topics.
Tag markets from explicit headline/description geography.
Missing or ambiguous geography requires review.
Route to review.csv for an editor to assess.
Includes weak/conflicting scores or data issues.
Exclude from the draft; keep the decision
Sort by category, then newest publication first.
Write a new, uniquely named report run
draft.csv: included stories | review.csv: flagged stories | decisions.csv: all candidate decisions
manifest.json: settings, counts and provenance; optional --evaluate adds a harvested-CSV comparison.

svg.text: Review the draft and flagged stories, resolve event-level duplicates, then finalize and send separately.
These scripts create draft files. Sending and updating finalized/sent history remain separate steps.

g.text: Collection exports use publication date (3 days).
Report candidates use firstEyes (72 hours by default).
A late-discovered older article can enter a report.
Topic score >= .55 and topic gap >= .10, unless overridden.
Solid arrows: processing or a decision branch.
Dashed arrows: saved-data input or exception/audit route.
Scores are initial rules; other flags can require review.

svg.text: Source: scripts/shipping.py, shippingReport.py, getFunc.py, newsFunc.py and aiFunc.py. Based on the local implementation.
Shipping and shippingReport.py are invoked separately; neither is in the current run_scripts.py batch list.
